page.overview:
What is Emerald City?

The Emerald City is a legendary metropolis mentioned by Bellamy during his speech about dreams, alongside the City of Gold and the One Piece. He dismissed them all as pure fantasy. So far, it is the only one of the three whose existence has yet to be confirmed.
